name: Surya Namaskar
description: A dynamic sequence of 12 postures coordinated with deep breathing. Surya Namaskar builds full-body strength, flexibility, and cardiovascular endurance.

steps.instruction: Stand tall and bring your palms together in prayer position.
steps.voice_prompt: Stand with feet together at the front of your mat, hands joined in prayer position.

steps.instruction: Inhale, reach arms up and arch back gently.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale deeply, raise your arms overhead, and gently arch back from the spine.

steps.instruction: Exhale, reach forward and fold down, placing palms on the mat.
steps.voice_prompt: Exhale, reach forward and fold down, placing palms or fingers beside your feet.

steps.instruction: Inhale, step your right leg back, rest knee on floor, and look up.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale, step your right leg back, place right knee down, and lift your chest looking up.

steps.instruction: Slide your left leg back, bringing your body into a straight plank.
steps.voice_prompt: Exhale, step your left leg back, aligning your hips and spine in a straight plank.

steps.instruction: Lower knees, chest, and chin down to the floor, hips slightly raised.
steps.voice_prompt: Lower your knees, chest, and chin to the mat, keeping your elbows close to your torso.

steps.instruction: Inhale, slide forward, press palms down, and lift chest up.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale, slide forward, and lift your chest into a gentle cobra stretch.

steps.instruction: Exhale, lift hips up and back into Downward-Facing Dog.
steps.voice_prompt: Exhale, lift your hips high and back, pressing your heels toward the mat.

steps.instruction: Inhale, step right foot forward between hands, left knee down, look up.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale, step your right foot forward between your hands, lower left knee, and look up.

steps.instruction: Step left foot forward to fold, then inhale, reach up and arch back.
steps.voice_prompt: Step left foot forward, fold down, then inhale, stand up, reach overhead and arch back.
